segments.text:
V. 4.
He entered into the Houſe of God—Into the Tabernacle. Th• Temple was not yet built. The ſhew bread—So they called the B•c•••
which the Prieſt, who ſerved that Week, put every Sabbath-day on the Golden Table that was in the Holy Place, before the LORD. The Loaves were twelve in Number, and repreſented the twelve Tribes of Iſrael: When the new were brought, the ſtale were taken away, but were to be eaten by the Prieſts only.
